# ABJ Kitchens and Bedrooms: Full Overview

> ABJ Kitchens and Bedrooms designs, makes and fits bespoke kitchens, fitted wardrobes, bedrooms, media walls and made-to-measure storage from its own workshop and showroom in Peterborough, UK. Free home design visit with a 3D design and an itemised quote, a 12-month guarantee on our work, and installation within about 80 miles of Peterborough.

## Key Facts (updated 12 Nov 2026)

- Trading name of AB Joinery Kitchens and Bedrooms Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company no. 11100736, incorporated in December 2017. Registered office: 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough PE1 2AZ. The team has around 20 years of joinery and fitted-furniture experience.
- 2,500+ bespoke projects completed
- Rated 4.9 out of 5 on Google from 100+ reviews

## About

ABJ Kitchens and Bedrooms (AB Joinery Kitchens and Bedrooms Ltd, company no. 11100736, incorporated December 2017) gives homeowners a made-to-measure alternative to standard showroom furniture. The team, with around 20 years of joinery and fitted-furniture experience, designs, makes and fits everything from its own workshop and showroom at 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough, PE1 2AZ. Because every piece is made in-house, furniture is built around the room, including alcoves, chimney breasts, sloping ceilings, uneven walls and full wall-to-wall runs. The same team that makes the furniture fits it.

## How It Works

1. Free design visit: a surveyor visits the home, measures up, talks through how the room is used and gives a rough idea of cost. No obligation.
2. 3D design and quote: the designers draw the room in 3D and prepare an itemised quote listing every cabinet, door and fitting. This is the actual price, including fitting.
3. Made in Peterborough: once the design is approved, the furniture is made in our workshop, usually in 4 to 6 weeks.
4. Fitted by our own team: kitchens usually take 1 to 2 weeks to fit; wardrobes and smaller rooms often take a few days. Work is covered by our 12-month guarantee.

## Pricing, Finance and Guarantee

A compact bespoke kitchen, made and fitted, starts from around £2,500, and a typical medium kitchen with quartz worktops comes to around £7,000 to £9,500. Larger kitchens, islands, premium worktops and appliances cost more. No exact price can be given before a visit: the surveyor gives a rough idea, and the designer's itemised quote gives the actual cost.

Interest-free finance is available on projects over £6,000 with a 50% deposit, subject to status: 12 months interest-free through Ideal4Finance. AB Joinery Kitchens and Bedrooms Ltd t/a ABJ Kitchens and Bedrooms is an introducer appointed representative of Ideal Sales Solutions Ltd t/a Ideal4Finance, a credit broker and not a lender (FRN 703401).

All work carries a 12-month guarantee. Longer manufacturer warranties can apply to some parts, such as hardware, worktops or appliances, depending on what you choose.

## Kitchens

Bespoke kitchens in handleless, Shaker, in-frame, traditional and island styles, planned around the layout, storage and appliances, with worktops, plumbing and electrics coordinated. Kitchen renovations are planned around what stays: keeping the sink and hob roughly where they are usually keeps the cost down. Islands need about 100cm of space around them; an island can hold the hob or sink, an overhang for bar stools, and deep drawers or bins. Kitchens for extensions can be designed from the architect's or builder's drawings and measured again once the walls are up. Supply-only kitchens are available for customers with their own fitter.

- [Bespoke Kitchens](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-kitchens): Handleless, Shaker and island kitchens made in our Peterborough workshop and fitted by our own team
- [Shaker and In-Frame Kitchens](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/shaker-kitchens-peterborough): Shaker and in-frame kitchens painted in any colour
- [Handleless Kitchens](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/handleless-kitchens-peterborough): True handleless kitchens with recessed rails, in matt or gloss
- [Kitchen Design](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/kitchen-design-peterborough): Free home design visit, 3D kitchen design and an itemised quote
- [Kitchen Cabinets and Units](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/kitchen-cabinets-peterborough): Made-to-measure, rigid cabinets with soft-close hinges and drawers
- [Supply-Only Kitchens](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/supply-only-kitchens-peterborough): Assembled bespoke cabinets supplied for you or your fitter to install
- [Worktops](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/luxury-worktops-abj): Quartz, granite, solid wood and compact laminate worktops supplied and fitted
- [Bespoke vs Off-the-Shelf Kitchens](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-vs-off-the-shelf-kitchens): How they differ on fit, materials, price and lead time
- [Kitchen Cost Guide](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/kitchen-cost-peterborough): How much a bespoke kitchen costs in Peterborough - compact from around £2,500, typical medium with quartz £7,000 to £9,500, made and fitted

## Wardrobes and Bedrooms

Fitted wardrobes with sliding, hinged or walk-in designs and interiors planned around what you own: hanging rails, adjustable shelves, soft-close drawers, shoe storage and lighting. Wardrobes are built to the exact angle of sloping and eaves ceilings. If a wardrobe frame is still sound, replacement sliding doors can be made in mirror, glass, woodgrain or painted panels. Fitted bedrooms can include bedside units, dressing tables, desks and headboards, and children's and teenagers' rooms with storage that adapts as they grow.

- [Fitted Wardrobes](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-wardrobes): Sliding, hinged and walk-in wardrobes made to measure
- [Sliding Wardrobes](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/sliding-wardrobes): Mirror, glass, wood-effect or painted doors, and replacement doors
- [Walk-In Wardrobes](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/walk-in-wardrobes): Walk-in wardrobes and dressing rooms
- [Wardrobes for Sloping Ceilings](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/fitted-wardrobes-sloping-ceilings): Wardrobes built to the angle of the roof
- [Fitted Bedrooms](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-bedrooms-abj): Complete bedrooms, including children's and teenagers' rooms
- [Bespoke Upholstery](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/upholstery): Headboards, window seat cushions and reupholstery

## Living Spaces and Storage

Media walls with a TV recess, electric fire, LED lighting, hidden cables and storage, plus TV wall units, low TV cabinets, floating TV units and home bars with lit glass shelves and wine racks. Alcove cupboards and shelving, bookcases and full library walls, and window seats with storage. Storage for under the stairs, alcoves, utility rooms, boot rooms, hallways and home offices, plus wall panelling, feature walls and bathroom cabinetry.

- [Media Walls](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/media-walls): TV walls, TV units, electric fires, lighting and home bars

- [Alcove Units](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/alcove-units): Alcove cupboards, shelving, bookcases, library walls and window seats

- [Hallway Storage](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-hallways): Hallway and entrance furniture
- [Home Offices](https://abjkitchensandbedrooms.co.uk/bespoke-office-renovations): Fitted desks, shelving and storage

## Service Area

Based in Peterborough and covering homes within about 80 miles, further for larger projects. Within Peterborough this includes Hampton, Orton, Werrington, Bretton, Stanground, Cardea and Great Haddon, and nearby Yaxley, Thorney, Ramsey, Crowland and Holbeach. New-build homes in Hampton, Cardea and Great Haddon often need wardrobes, media walls or a replacement for the developer's kitchen.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much does a bespoke fitted kitchen cost? A: A compact bespoke kitchen, made and fitted, starts from around £2,500, and a typical medium kitchen with quartz worktops comes to around £7,000 to £9,500. The surveyor gives a rough idea at the free design visit, and the designer's itemised quote gives the actual price.

Q: Is the design visit free? A: Yes. We visit your home, measure up and talk through how you use the room, then send a 3D design and an itemised quote. There is no obligation.

Q: Is everything made to measure? A: Yes. Every piece is made in our Peterborough workshop to your measurements, including alcoves, sloping ceilings, uneven walls and wall-to-wall runs.

Q: Who fits the furniture? A: Our own fitters, the same team that makes it.

Q: How long does it take? A: Usually 4 to 6 weeks to make after the design is approved, then 1 to 2 weeks to fit a kitchen. Wardrobes and smaller rooms often take a few days to fit.

Q: What guarantee do you give? A: 12 months on our work. Longer manufacturer warranties can apply to some parts depending on what you choose.

Q: Is finance available? A: Yes, 12 months interest-free through Ideal4Finance on projects over £6,000 with a 50% deposit, subject to status.

Q: Can I visit the showroom? A: Yes. The showroom is at 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough PE1 2AZ, open Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm and Saturday 10am to 2pm. Call 01733 686767 before you travel.

Q: Do you supply kitchens without fitting? A: Yes. Supply-only kitchens are made in our workshop as rigid, assembled cabinets for you or your own fitter to install.

Q: Can you replace just the doors on my wardrobe? A: Often, yes. If the frame is sound we can make replacement sliding doors to fit the existing opening. Send a photo and the size of the opening on WhatsApp (07479 219421).

Q: Can you work around sloping ceilings and awkward spaces? A: Yes. Made-to-measure furniture suits alcoves, loft slopes, chimney breasts, box sections and uneven walls, because each piece is made for the actual room.

Q: Can you include an electric fire in a media wall? A: Yes, where suitable. The joinery is designed around the fire with the right clearances, and cables for the TV and devices are hidden. Specialist electrical work is done by a qualified person.

Q: Which areas do you cover? A: Homes within about 80 miles of Peterborough, including Stamford, Oundle, Market Deeping, Bourne, Spalding, Oakham, Grantham, Huntingdon, St Ives, Ely, Wisbech, Cambridge, St Neots, Corby, Kettering, March, Whittlesey, Chatteris and King's Lynn.
